name: OPEN Group,Inc.
summary: OPEN Group, Inc. and its subsidiaries form a technology company with Intellectual Property, Robot Transformation and RaaS segments. Its products are BizRobo, a software robot for routine tasks, PRESCO, a performance-based advertising service, and RoboRobo, cloud back-office tools; it also outsources sales. Formerly RPA Holdings, Inc., it renamed itself in June 2024 and was incorporated in 2000.
